description: This Java class 'Decoder' is responsible for decoding specific key data strings and applying corresponding input events to an Android InputConnection. It interprets certain command strings ('DEL', 'ENT', 'SPA') as specific key events and otherwise commits text directly.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: A class for decoding key data and applying input changes to an Android InputConnection.

methods.name: decodeAndApply
methods.description: Decodes the string data and sends corresponding key events or commits text to the InputConnection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the InputConnection's text before and after the cursor is empty.
